exceptions.reason: Build-time only: electron-builder -> app-builder-lib -> @electron/get 3 -> got 11 -> cacheable-request 7. It is not shipped in the app, and got only reaches it when a request sets a cache store, which nothing in that chain does, so there is no shared cache to disclose.
